observations: A yellow field fills the left two-thirds; two oval eye-shapes with red X marks and spike-like lash rows sit side by side near the upper center, with a round open-mouthed form below them.
A band of thick parallel blue stripes sweeps diagonally across the right half, overlapping a dark gray area filled with pink loops and small yellow spirals.
White hand-lettered marks run horizontally across the mid-section, flanked by dense cross-hatching in red, green, and black covering the lower-left quadrant.
reading: Two X-marked ovals and a round open form read as a face pressed flat against the picture plane. The blue stripe band cuts hard across the right half, splitting the warm yellow field from a cooler gray zone of pink loops and spirals. Dense cross-hatching in the lower left sits in contrast to that quieter spiral area. White lettered marks hold the middle ground, functioning as visual form rather than readable text.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #115 offers a sharp contrast: soft blurred circles and muted warm tones against this work's hard lines and saturated yellow. The collector's interest in emotional range finds both poles in adjacent titles.

connections.reason: Both works use rectangular or oval eye-zones with internal marks and dense overlapping line work to build a frontal face-like structure, though nifty faces #17 sits on a flat teal ground while #116 layers stripes over yellow.
nnotb #117 shares the yellow-dominant field and spiked-lash eye forms, but spreads multiple figures across a cooler blue-gray ground rather than concentrating one dense face-zone as #116 does.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the band of blue stripes begin relative to the oval eye-shapes, and what happens to the forms underneath it?
ambiguities: The white horizontal marks read as lettering but their content is not legible at this resolution; treated as visual form only.
nnotb #115 is retained in contextAngle as a contrast only; no shared visual structure supports a positive connection, so it is excluded from connections.
